sources.title: Community Guidelines strike basics on YouTube - YouTube Help
sources.key_facts: Warning (first violation, 90-day expiry with optional policy training); Strike 1: 1-week upload freeze; Strike 2: 2-week freeze (within same 90-day window); Strike 3: channel permanent removal; all strikes last 90 days from issuance

sources.title: Appeal a Community Guidelines strike or video removal - YouTube Help
sources.key_facts: Appeal window: 6 months for strikes/warnings; 1 year for content removals (videos, posts, playlists, thumbnails, URLs); each strike may be appealed only once; three outcomes: reinstated, age-restricted, or upheld; no additional penalty for rejected appeals

sources.title: YouTube Community Guidelines Enforcement FAQs - Transparency Report Help Center
sources.key_facts: Warning precedes first strike; strike 1 = 1-week posting ban; strike 2 = 2-week ban; strike 3 within 90 days = channel termination; human reviewers evaluate 24/7; flagged content not automatically removed; creator right to appeal (except privacy-based removals)

sources.title: YouTube's Community Guidelines - YouTube Help
sources.key_facts: 5 main policy categories: Spam & Deceptive Practices, Sensitive Content, Violent or Dangerous Content, Regulated Goods, Misinformation; sub-categories include Hate Speech, Harassment & Cyberbullying, Child Safety, Medical Misinformation, Elections Misinformation; applies to all content types

sources.title: Restricting accounts - Meta Transparency Center
sources.key_facts: Strike 1: warning only; Strikes 2-6: restricted from specific features (e.g. group posting) for limited time; Strike 7: 1-day content creation ban; Strike 8: 3-day ban; Strike 9: 7-day ban; Strike 10+: 30-day restriction; severe policy violations (e.g. CSAM, dangerous orgs) trigger additional longer restrictions from Strike 1

sources.title: Community Standards - Meta Transparency Center
sources.key_facts: 27 policy categories including: Coordinating Harm, Dangerous Organizations and Individuals, Fraud/Scams/Deceptive Practices, Violence and Incitement, Adult Sexual Exploitation, Bullying and Harassment, CSAM, Human Exploitation, Suicide/Self-Injury/Eating Disorders, Hateful Conduct, Privacy Violations, Violent and Graphic Content, Cybersecurity, Inauthentic Behavior, Misinformation, Spam; four core values: authenticity, safety, privacy, dignity

sources.title: Community Standards Enforcement | Transparency Center
sources.key_facts: H2 2025 report: Q4 2025 violent/graphic content on Facebook decreased to 0.15%-0.16% (from 0.19%-0.20%) due to proactive detection adjustments; adult nudity on Instagram increased to 0.09%-0.11%; false positives increased >100% briefly in Q4 due to a bug

sources.title: Integrity Reports, Third Quarter 2025 | Transparency Center
sources.key_facts: Q3 2025: <1% of content removed for policy violations; <0.1% removed incorrectly; enforcement precision >90% on Facebook, >87% on Instagram; ~1 in 10 removed pieces were errors (<1 in 1000 overall); NCMEC CyberTips: 2M+ reports (486K inappropriate child interactions, 1.6M CSAM imagery); increases in adult nudity, violent/graphic content, bullying/harassment

sources.title: TikTok Content Violations and Bans - TikTok Support
sources.key_facts: Strike expiry: 90 days; three-strike policy leading to permanent ban; enforcement actions: video removal, shadowban/reach reduction, account warning/strikes, permanent ban; appeal process: tap Appeal in notification, safety team reviews per Community Guidelines; successful appeal reinstates content and removes penalty

sources.title: TikTok Community Guidelines Enforcement Report Q1 2025
sources.key_facts: Q1 2025 global: 211,000,000 videos removed (~0.9% of all uploads); automated detection: 184,378,987 videos (~87.4%); reinstated after review: 7,525,184; proactive removal rate: 99.0%; removed within 24 hours: 94.3%; violation breakdown: sensitive/mature 30.1%, misinformation 45.5%, edited media/AI-generated 13.8%, safety/civility 11.5%, privacy/security 15.6%

sources.title: Content Moderation, Enforcement, and Appeals – Reddit Help
sources.key_facts: Enforcement tiers: warning → 3-day suspension → 7-day suspension → permanent ban; certain violations (e.g. CSAM) trigger immediate permanent ban; appeal window: 6 months; appeals processed in timely, non-discriminatory, diligent, non-arbitrary manner; content/account notifications include removal reason and appeal instructions

sources.title: Reddit's New York S895B/A6789B Terms of Service Report, January 2026
sources.key_facts: H1 2025 admin enforcement: Harassment 68,550 removed (58.6% automated), 71,114 appeals, 40.7% reversal; Hateful content 98,798 removed (77.2% automated), 53,021 appeals, 30.0% reversal; Terrorism 980 removed (81.0% automated), 48.0% actionability, 364 appeals, 0.5% reversal; Account-level appeal reversals: Harassment 25.0%, Hateful 27.6%, Terrorism 0.5%; Reddit Rule 1 defines hateful content; Rule 2 prohibits content manipulation; Rule 5 prohibits sharing manipulated content; enforcement tiers: warning, 3-day suspension, 7-day suspension, permanent ban; User Agreement effective June 28, 2025
